title: Card-testing burst of tiny charges from a shared device behind a foreign VPN
narrative: The card has been charged seven or eight times in the past hour, each a few dollars at a digital-goods merchant. This charge is $3.17. The device has never been seen on this account and is also used by other accounts, and the IP is a VPN exit in a different country from the billing address.
rationale: Rapid repeated micro-charges are the signature of card testing, and the shared unrecognized device and anonymized foreign IP rule out an innocent explanation. Decline. High and critical are both acceptable severities.
